lines: Welcome to Turn the Page. I'm Lionel Page. Yes, really. With a name like that, what else could I do?
A quiet evening on the green. Best place to finish a chapter.

rotate: Theo's my best customer. Reads a book a day. Sometimes two. Never buys one. I don't mind.
The cat? That's Footnote. She sleeps on the mystery shelf. She's solved most of them.
I've a book about portals to other worlds. Fiction, of course. Of course! ...Mostly fiction.
Halloween's my favourite season for books. Ghost stories, pumpkin stories, a pumpkin who's a ghost...
